options.description: Answers are saved with their source and used for the letter. The lookahead letter is rebuilt after you answer. A recorded answer for the same company is shown for you to confirm instead of asked again. Recommended: it matches the saving and regeneration you asked for and is the more useful default.
options.label: Save answers, regenerate lookahead, confirm recorded answers (Recommended)

options.description: Answers are used for the letter in the session but not saved. Existing lookahead letters are left as they are. Every letter asks the questions again from scratch.
options.label: Ask every time, change nothing else

payload.question: When you answer the cover letter questions, should those answers be saved with a note of where they came from, and should an existing lookahead letter be regenerated once you have answered? Should a recorded answer for the same company be shown back to you for confirmation instead of asked again?
payload.text: Save answers, regenerate lookahead, confirm recorded answers (Recommended)
